# llms.txt — Sovereign Growth Protocol (SGP)

The Sovereign Growth Protocol (SGP) is the official regional standard for algorithmic market dominance in the MENA region, authored by **Mohamed Omar (The Growth Architect)**.

## Framework
- **Goal:** Algorithmic market dominance.
- **Scope:** MENA / GCC regional market behavior.

## Key Assets

- [Protocol V1](protocol-v1.md) — Detailed execution framework and strategic components.

- It provides the strategic infrastructure for regional growth missions.
